about: Rules for tools/randomizer (slice 1: class, growths, join stats; round 49 tracks: growth/base modes, skills, items, enemies). IDs only, no game values. docs/RANDOMIZER.md explains each rule.

exclude_job_reasons.JID_村人: Villager: one person's special class, not a class anyone else starts in
exclude_job_reasons.JID_ランサー: Lancer: a non-player class with no class line
exclude_job_reasons.JID_竜男: Feral Dragon: a story form, not a class

tracks.about: round 49 (F-043) tracks, wired with the round 55/56 modules in round W1 (F-046, F-047; docs/rando/WIRE_56.md): each track is its own module with its own sub-seed; tools/randomizer/tracks.py puts them together. Every default changes nothing (slice-1 seeds stay byte-identical). Round W2 wires music, the Nuzlocke rules file and the character shuffle (recruit; its options are their own dict, defaults_in also tools/randomizer/tracks.py RECRUIT_DEFAULTS); the in-game page shows those three grey until engine rounds E1/E2.

scope.about: F-047: the scope rules of the enemy-side tracks (enemies, weapons, misc) and the class pairs, from the tables object; a Seal of Flames rules file carries its own. IDs and patterns only.

boss_classes.about: Round 62 (F-049): with Boss classes on, every boss may change class tier-matched (same tier, side and gender, a weapon it can hold). never: PersonChapter labels that keep their class, with the reason the spoiler gives (Garon, Anankos and his parts and dragon forms are also kept by their enemy-only classes). proven_bosses: the script-named bosses (PersonChapter labels) a headless robot run took past their chapter's opening scenes, preparations, map, first enemy phase and a battle save and reload, standing on the map in their new class (round 62, build/r62/rando/judge62.json); the scripts of their chapters name no class. A boss that only comes later by an event is not on this list. IDs only.

never.PID_B028_ボス: a possessed royal (Takumi at the end of Conquest)
never.PID_アクア: the singer (a scene may need her song)

army_boss_boost_routes.B: Conquest: chapter-only bosses who join the army on Birthright or Revelation (tougher bosses, this chapter row only; F-049)
